patch_description:
This version replaces the all-interior free-point encoding with a boundary-aware parameterization: the three container vertices are retained, one additional point is placed on each side, and five points remain free inside the triangle. This is useful for Heilbronn-style configurations because strong solutions frequently use boundary support points, while the original continuous encoding is unlikely to discover exact boundary points.

The search combines vectorized differential evolution with a smooth minimum-area surrogate during global exploration. The surrogate rewards improving several nearly-active triangle constraints instead of only the current worst triangle, helping the population escape nonsmooth plateaus. A deterministic local batch refinement then optimizes the true minimum doubled area. The best true configuration is tracked independently throughout.
